text:
Noah Kim: Quick proposal 1-week micro experiment: pair a modest credit grant with a tiny prompt template gallery + a timed webinar nudge. Goal: increase 7-day activation by 10% and boost credit redemption.

Alana Ruiz: yes. let's keep it lean: 3 arms (control, $10 basic, $20 prompt-pack). cohort size ~900 each. prioritize speed over long run.

Priya Nair: i'll write a 3-template prompt-pack (support reply, product search, short marketing blurb) with 2 examples each and clear usage notes. Need design assets for the gallery card.

Noah Kim: measurement: events = marketing.plg.awarded, marketing.plg.redeemed, marketing.plg.first_generate, marketing.plg.retention_7d. routing: if redeemed AND embedding_calls > 3 -> create HubSpot lead tag 'plg-credit-activated'.

Alana Ruiz: Webinar tie-in: 20-min "Practical prompts: get reliable results" for credit redeemers in week 1. attendees get a $5 bonus credit. Invite via in-app banner + transactional email.

Priya Nair: small UX idea: add a micro-task card "Run this starter prompt" and mark completion when first_generate succeeds. that'll give time_to_first_success.

growth-bot: Experiment EXP-2026-078 created. Variants: Control, V1 ($10 basic), V2 ($20 prompt-pack). Funnels configured: signup -> credit_awarded -> first_generate -> retention_7d. Dashboard request queued.

Noah Kim: next steps: Priya -> prompts by Tue EOD. Alana -> in-app + email assets by Wed. I'll add tracking spec and routing rules to the experiment brief.

Alana Ruiz: will mock gallery card and email copy. ping me for fast reviews.

Priya Nair: will include recommended temp, max tokens, and a one-line intent blurb for each template.

Noah Kim: thanks team. keeping this small and measurable. i'll publish brief and tag ops when ready. :rocket:
